latest_release.name: v0.1.18
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Move agent-run turn helpers into focused modules by @ReganBell in https://github.com/yc-software/qm/pull/3307
* Turn on ALB access logs in the AWS scaffold by @ReganBell in https://github.com/yc-software/qm/pull/3311
* Keep HTTP keep-alive sockets open longer than the ALB idle timeout by @ReganBell in https://github.com/yc-software/qm/pull/3154
* Remove model and timezone limits nobody chose by @ReganBell in https://github.com/yc-software/qm/pull/3317
* Keep the transcript still while reading backscroll by @ReganBell in https://github.com/yc-software/qm/pull/3290
* Move subagent return and delivery-state bookkeeping out of the run store factory by @ReganBell in https://github.com/yc-software/qm/pull/3319
* Proxy WebSocket upgrades to published apps by @ReganBell in https://github.com/yc-software/qm/pull/3137
* Keep error evidence in gateway discovery, ChatGPT auth files and command failures by @ReganBell in https://github.com/yc-software/qm/pull/3308
* Make always-wired orchestrator deps required and drop their dead guards by @ReganBell in https://github.com/yc-software/qm/pull/3313
* Move runTurn stream, request-record and settle helpers into modules by @ReganBell in https://github.com/yc-software/qm/pull/3327
* Keep one provider list and one tool-output retention period by @ReganBell in https://github.com/yc-software/qm/pull/3315
* Move run lookups out of the run store factory into their own module by @ReganBell in https://github.com/yc-software/qm/pull/3329
* Move turn skill materialisation out of the turn sandbox pool by @ReganBell in https://github.com/yc-software/qm/pull/3310
* Find delegated sandbox execution in the live Slack provider scenarios by @ReganBell in https://github.com/yc-software/qm/pull/3328
* Move turn credential catalog registration into orchestrator/credential-catalog.ts by @ReganBell in https://github.com/yc-software/qm/pull/3331
* Keep later messages centered when side chats are in backscroll by @ReganBell in https://github.com/yc-software/qm/pull/3332
* Refuse private network addresses for custom model provider calls by @garrytan in https://github.com/yc-software/qm/pull/3293
* Keep a Slack bot out of a person's swarm work by @garrytan in https://github.com/yc-software/qm/pull/3298
* Move turn sandbox access planning into sandbox-resources by @ReganBell in https://github.com/yc-software/qm/pull/3320
* Move runTurn opening steps into turn-open.ts by @ReganBell in https://github.com/yc-software/qm/pull/3333
* Drop the session_leases table on live databases by @ReganBell in https://github.com/yc-software/qm/pull/3025
* Keep the Slack twin's runtime files out of git by @garrytan in https://github.com/yc-software/qm/pull/3330
* Bind tenants and isolate failures in the event bus, not in each subscriber by @ReganBell in https://github.com/yc-software/qm/pull/3309
* Send each turn only its own documents by @ReganBell in https://github.com/yc-software/qm/pull/3318
* Refuse a memory brain link's form once its owner loses access by @garrytan in https://github.com/yc-software/qm/pull/3314
* Retire subagents after their final answer unless opened persistent by @ReganBell in https://github.com/yc-software/qm/pull/3295
* Move turn capability-token minting into orchestrator/capability-tokens.ts by @ReganBell in https://github.com/yc-software/qm/pull/3334
* Drop items.target_seq on live databases by @ReganBell in https://github.com/yc-software/qm/pull/2816
* Move turn effort and reasoning-mode helpers into turn-effort.ts by @ReganBell in https://github.com/yc-software/qm/pull/3343
* Move stale turn-file cleanup into the attachments module by @ReganBell in https://github.com/yc-software/qm/pull/3321
* [Draft, pending prod-data evals] Ambient judge reads the same recent messages as its worker by @ReganBell in https://github.com/yc-software/qm/pull/3118
* Move the turn sandbox pool's release out of createTurnSandboxes by @ReganBell in https://github.com/yc-software/qm/pull/3322
* Stop a restarted run
